WAB_2010_p73__paragraph_1.ocr:
The 401(k) savings plan is a participant directed defined contribution plan that holds shares of the
Company’s stock as one of the investment options. At December 31, 2010 and 2009, the plan held on behalf of
its participants about 433,300 shares with a market value of $22.9 million, and 428,000 shares with a market
value of $17.5 million, respectively.
